text_visible: 我自己是做机器人操作、做具身的。可能在做具身的人看来，world model有一个比较狭义、原教旨主义的定义，也有一个更宽泛的定义。

details: Exiting beneath the exterior canopy onto the wide stone paving.

details: Looking at the companion's hand and phone gesture outside the exterior library wall.

action: I walk out into the central open plaza past a multi-globe street lamppost.

details: Walking forward into the open square under daylight.

action: I stand in the open paved plaza looking ahead toward the distant building entrance.

Sha Tin Public Library building stands to the left with red-brick walls. An arched pavilion and high-rise residential towers sit in the far background. Several pedestrians walk across the plaza, including a man with a red backpack ahead. No electronic screens visible.
details: My gaze focuses on the distant entrance across the plaza.

action: My companion turns and points to the right, saying '不是，这边'.
action_brief: My companion says '不是，这边'.

action: I ask '咋了？'.
action_brief: I ask '咋了？'.
environment: No change.
details: I look down at the plaza paving while asking.

action: I scan across the wide plaza toward the covered pavilion and the Sha Tin Public Library building.
action_brief: I scan the plaza.
environment: The Sha Tin Public Library sign comes clearly into view on the red-brick facade on the left. National flags are visible near the background pavilion.
details: I look up and across the left side of the plaza.

action: I look toward the library building and ask '哪个近？'.
action_brief: I ask '哪个近？'.
environment: My companion re-enters the left foreground walking ahead.
details: I fixate on the library walkway as I speak.

action: I turn toward the building on the right and walk forward as my companion leads the way.
action_brief: I walk toward the building entrance.
environment: Facing the building entrance with glass doors under an overhang, bordered by a large curved white column and a black classical lamppost.
details: I walk forward across the plaza tiles following my companion.

action: I walk up the accessible ramp between stainless steel handrails toward the building entrance.
action_brief: I walk up the ramp.
environment: Approaching and ascending an outdoor pedestrian ramp fitted with dual-height stainless steel railings and yellow tactile warning studs at the base.
details: I step onto the tactile ground indicator and walk up the ramp.

action: I ask '哪个近？' while standing under the outdoor covered walkway facing the building entrance.
action_brief: I ask '哪个近？'
environment: Outdoor covered entrance hallway outside a multi-story building. Pink cylindrical pillar in foreground, dark-tinted window panels to the right reflecting warm interior ceiling lights. Gray tiled floor with directional tactile paving studs. Overcast daylight outside, with pedestrians walking in the courtyard.
details: I look toward the dark glass window next to the supporting pillar.

action: I say '嗯。' while walking along the covered walkway following a companion toward the sliding entrance doors.
action_brief: I say '嗯。'
environment: Bright daylight filtering into the walkway. A companion dressed in white with a brown backpack walks ahead descending shallow steps.
details: I step forward following the companion along the tactile ground strip.

action: I walk through the automatic sliding glass doors into the indoor lobby.
action_brief: I enter through the sliding doors.
environment: Transition from outdoor slatted canopy to warm indoor lighting. The lobby has polished brown granite floors, recessed square ceiling lamps, and white columns.
details: I follow my companion through the glass doorway into the lobby.

action: I raise my hand in front of my face to adjust my glasses while continuing to walk inside the lobby.
action_brief: I raise my hand.
environment: Lobby interior with warm illuminated square ceiling coves, shiny polished marble floor, and digital information pillars in the distance.
details: My left hand briefly obstructs the field of view as I adjust my smart glasses.

action: I walk past a square white pillar displaying event posters for HK POP Culturefest and French May.
action_brief: I walk past event posters.
environment: Large white square pillar mounted with vertical advertising displays showing cultural event posters. People seated on low benches along the left wall.
details: My gaze focuses on the colorful event posters on the pillar face.

action: I walk across the expansive lobby toward the main grand staircase and service counters.
action_brief: I walk across the lobby.
environment: Spacious high-ceiling lobby with bright ceiling coves, glossy floor reflecting ambient lights, a wide central staircase on the left, and a counter area straight ahead.
details: I walk forward along the open marble floor toward the central stairs.

action: I approach the base of the wide staircase and observe the large video screen above the reception counter.
action_brief: I approach the staircase.
environment: Grand staircase with polished handrails and red velvet stanchion dividers on the left. In the background, a large digital LED screen above the service desk displays '大幕'.
details: I slow down near the base of the staircase and look toward the reception video wall.

action: I stand in the building lobby looking at the staircase and the electronic display board above the reception counter switching between graphics.
action_brief: I look at the lobby screen and staircase.
environment: A modern multi-story indoor lobby with polished granite tile flooring, recessed ceiling lighting with a large circular central light fixture, a curved blue and white reception counter on the left, a wall-mounted digital display screen cycling through event visuals ('天幕', 'PROSCENIUM'), a pillar with a blue and yellow floor directory sign, and a staircase leading down and up to adjacent floors.
details: I face toward the staircase entrance and the corner directory pillar while the electronic screen cycles through graphic slides.

action: I turn around in the lobby and glance at my companion approaching in a white shirt and green top.
action_brief: I glance at my companion.
environment: The opposite view of the wide open lobby area shows illuminated ceiling fixtures, large glass windows leading outdoors in the background, and vertical digital poster boards.
details: I pivot my body around to face the center of the lobby hall as my companion walks forward.

action: I turn back and walk down the flight of stairs toward the lower floor corridor.
action_brief: I walk down the stairs.
environment: Three students in school uniforms (plaid skirts and white shirts) walk across the lower hallway. Digital poster displays and an elevator landing are visible on the lower floor.
details: I descend the granite steps, guided by stainless steel handrails, stepping onto the lower ground level tactile paving.

action: I walk along the lower floor corridor past the elevator and service kiosks toward the accessible restroom door.
action_brief: I walk along the corridor.
environment: The lower corridor features marble-clad walls, elevator doors, an illuminated concert poster board ('ANNUAL CONCERT'), self-service kiosks, and dark blue restroom doors equipped with white wheelchair symbols and grab bars.
details: I walk straight down the hallway approaching the dark blue accessible restroom door on the right.

action: I reach toward the accessible restroom door handle, turn back as my companion points down the hallway, and hear her say '好。 no no no，哦， OK。'
action_brief: My companion says '好。 no no no，哦， OK。'
environment: My companion stands in the lower corridor near the stairs, pointing her left arm toward the elevator area.
speech: 好。 no no no，哦， OK。
details: I turn my head left to look at my companion as she gestures with her arm and speaks, then look toward the elevator doors.

action: I turn back to the accessible restroom door, press down on the door lever with my right hand, and push the door open.
action_brief: I open the accessible restroom door.
environment: The accessible restroom opens to reveal grey tiled walls, a horizontal stainless steel safety grab bar, and light-colored floor tiles illuminated by overhead recessed lighting.
details: I grasp the silver door latch with my right hand, press it down, and push the dark blue door inward to enter.
